notes: Warm Up (Browser Mode): new task 'Page Create After 7days' under Professional Mode - tick it by hand (All leaves it off). From the account's 7th warm-up day it makes one new Facebook Page a day in the middle of a normal warm-up session: an English/international name with a category that matches it (a person = Digital creator / Personal blog / Doctor / Actor..., a shop = its shop category, a brand = a brand category - only categories Facebook really offers), a matching high-quality profile picture and cover photo, a bio, then it switches back to the personal profile and carries on with the warm-up. Works in m and web mode.
